definitions.name: Cleric
definitions.summary: Divine spellcaster whose god grants healing, protection and power.

definitions.name: Knowledge Domain
definitions.summary: Cleric of lore and learning: extra languages and expertise, and divine insight into minds and the past.

definitions.name: Blessings of Knowledge
definitions.summary: Learn two languages, and gain proficiency with doubled proficiency bonus in two of Arcana, History, Nature or Religion.

definitions.name: Domain Spells
definitions.summary: Always prepared, not counted against your prepared spells: Command, Identify.

definitions.name: Domain Spells (3rd)
definitions.summary: Always prepared, not counted against your prepared spells: Augury, Suggestion.

definitions.name: Domain Spells (5th)
definitions.summary: Always prepared, not counted against your prepared spells: Nondetection, Speak with Dead.

definitions.name: Domain Spells (7th)
definitions.summary: Always prepared, not counted against your prepared spells: Arcane Eye, Confusion.

definitions.name: Domain Spells (9th)
definitions.summary: Always prepared, not counted against your prepared spells: Legend Lore, Scrying.

definitions.name: Channel Divinity: Knowledge of the Ages
definitions.summary: Action: for 10 minutes you are proficient with one skill or tool of your choice.

actions.name: Knowledge of the Ages
actions.note: Pick a skill or tool: proficient with it for 10 minutes.

definitions.name: Channel Divinity: Read Thoughts
definitions.summary: Action: a creature within 60 ft makes a Wisdom save or you read its surface thoughts for 1 minute; meanwhile you can end it to cast Suggestion on it without a slot (no save against it).

actions.name: Read Thoughts
actions.note: Creature within 60 ft, Wisdom save vs your spell DC. On a fail: read surface thoughts for 1 minute; you may end it to cast Suggestion on it, no slot, auto-fail.

definitions.name: Potent Spellcasting
definitions.summary: Add your Wisdom modifier to the damage of any cleric cantrip you cast.

when.text: cleric cantrip damage

definitions.name: Visions of the Past
definitions.summary: Meditate for up to a minute (concentration) to see visions of an object's past owners or of events in your surroundings; once per short or long rest.

actions.name: Visions of the Past
actions.note: Object reading or area reading, up to 1 minute of meditation.

definitions.name: Light Domain
definitions.summary: Cleric of fire and radiance who dazzles attackers and burns away darkness.

definitions.name: Bonus Cantrip
definitions.summary: You know the Light cantrip; it doesn't count against your cantrips known.

definitions.name: Warding Flare
definitions.summary: Reaction when a creature within 30 ft that you can see attacks you: impose disadvantage on the roll (not on creatures immune to blindness). Uses equal your Wisdom modifier (min 1) per long rest.

actions.name: Warding Flare
actions.note: An attacker within 30 ft has disadvantage on its attack roll.

definitions.name: Domain Spells
definitions.summary: Always prepared, not counted against your prepared spells: Burning Hands, Faerie Fire.

definitions.name: Domain Spells (3rd)
definitions.summary: Always prepared, not counted against your prepared spells: Flaming Sphere, Scorching Ray.

definitions.name: Domain Spells (5th)
definitions.summary: Always prepared, not counted against your prepared spells: Daylight, Fireball.

definitions.name: Domain Spells (7th)
definitions.summary: Always prepared, not counted against your prepared spells: Guardian of Faith, Wall of Fire.

definitions.name: Domain Spells (9th)
definitions.summary: Always prepared, not counted against your prepared spells: Flame Strike, Scrying.

definitions.name: Channel Divinity: Radiance of the Dawn
definitions.summary: Action: dispel magical darkness within 30 ft, and hostile creatures there make a Constitution save, taking 2d10 + cleric level radiant damage (half on a success).

actions.name: Radiance of the Dawn
actions.note: Hostiles within 30 ft: Con save, 2d10 + cleric level radiant (half on success). Ends magical darkness.

definitions.name: Improved Flare
definitions.summary: Warding Flare can also protect another creature attacked within 30 ft of you.

definitions.name: Potent Spellcasting
definitions.summary: Add your Wisdom modifier to the damage of any cleric cantrip you cast.

when.text: cleric cantrip damage

definitions.name: Corona of Light
definitions.summary: Action: for 1 minute you shed bright light 60 ft; enemies in it have disadvantage on saves against spells dealing fire or radiant damage.

actions.name: Corona of Light
actions.note: Bright light 60 ft; enemies in it: disadvantage on saves vs your fire/radiant spells. Dismiss as an action.

definitions.name: Nature Domain
definitions.summary: Cleric of the wild who commands beasts and plants and shrugs off the elements.

definitions.name: Acolyte of Nature
definitions.summary: Learn one druid cantrip (counts as a cleric cantrip) and gain proficiency in Animal Handling, Nature or Survival.

definitions.name: Bonus Proficiency
definitions.summary: Proficiency with heavy armor.

definitions.name: Domain Spells
definitions.summary: Always prepared, not counted against your prepared spells: Animal Friendship, Speak with Animals.

definitions.name: Domain Spells (3rd)
definitions.summary: Always prepared, not counted against your prepared spells: Barkskin, Spike Growth.

definitions.name: Domain Spells (5th)
definitions.summary: Always prepared, not counted against your prepared spells: Plant Growth, Wind Wall.

definitions.name: Domain Spells (7th)
definitions.summary: Always prepared, not counted against your prepared spells: Dominate Beast, Grasping Vine.

definitions.name: Domain Spells (9th)
definitions.summary: Always prepared, not counted against your prepared spells: Insect Plague, Tree Stride.

definitions.name: Channel Divinity: Charm Animals and Plants
definitions.summary: Action: beasts and plant creatures within 30 ft that can see you make a Wisdom save or are charmed by you for 1 minute or until harmed.

actions.name: Charm Animals and Plants
actions.note: Beasts and plants within 30 ft: Wisdom save or charmed for 1 minute (ends if damaged).

definitions.name: Dampen Elements
definitions.summary: Reaction when you or a creature within 30 ft takes acid, cold, fire, lightning or thunder damage: grant resistance to that instance.

actions.name: Dampen Elements
actions.note: You or a creature within 30 ft resists one instance of acid, cold, fire, lightning or thunder damage.

definitions.name: Divine Strike
definitions.summary: Once on each of your turns, a weapon hit deals an extra 1d8 cold, fire or lightning damage (your pick); 2d8 from 14th level.

when.text: once on each of your turns, on a weapon hit; cold, fire or lightning

definitions.name: Master of Nature
definitions.summary: Bonus action: give verbal commands to creatures charmed by your Charm Animals and Plants.

actions.name: Master of Nature
actions.note: Command creatures you charmed with Charm Animals and Plants; they act on their next turn.

definitions.name: Tempest Domain
definitions.summary: Storm cleric in heavy armor who answers blows with thunder and maximizes lightning.

definitions.name: Bonus Proficiencies
definitions.summary: Proficiency with martial weapons and heavy armor.

definitions.name: Wrath of the Storm
definitions.summary: Reaction when a creature within 5 ft hits you: it makes a Dexterity save, taking 2d8 lightning or thunder damage (half on success). Uses equal your Wisdom modifier (min 1) per long rest.

actions.name: Wrath of the Storm
actions.note: Attacker within 5 ft: Dex save, 2d8 lightning or thunder (half on success).

definitions.name: Domain Spells
definitions.summary: Always prepared, not counted against your prepared spells: Fog Cloud, Thunderwave.

definitions.name: Domain Spells (3rd)
definitions.summary: Always prepared, not counted against your prepared spells: Gust of Wind, Shatter.

definitions.name: Domain Spells (5th)
definitions.summary: Always prepared, not counted against your prepared spells: Call Lightning, Sleet Storm.

definitions.name: Domain Spells (7th)
definitions.summary: Always prepared, not counted against your prepared spells: Control Water, Ice Storm.

definitions.name: Domain Spells (9th)
definitions.summary: Always prepared, not counted against your prepared spells: Destructive Wave, Insect Plague.

definitions.name: Channel Divinity: Destructive Wrath
definitions.summary: When you roll lightning or thunder damage, deal the maximum instead of rolling.

actions.name: Destructive Wrath
actions.note: Your lightning or thunder damage roll counts as the maximum.

definitions.name: Thunderbolt Strike
definitions.summary: When you deal lightning damage to a Large or smaller creature, you can push it up to 10 ft away.

definitions.name: Divine Strike
definitions.summary: Once on each of your turns, a weapon hit deals an extra 1d8 thunder damage (2d8 from 14th level).

when.text: once on each of your turns, on a weapon hit

definitions.name: Stormborn
definitions.summary: You have a flying speed equal to your walking speed whenever you're not underground or indoors.

definitions.name: Trickery Domain
definitions.summary: Cleric of deception who conjures illusory duplicates and slips into shadow.

definitions.name: Blessing of the Trickster
definitions.summary: Action: another willing creature you touch has advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks for 1 hour or until you use this again.

actions.name: Blessing of the Trickster
actions.note: A willing creature you touch (not you): advantage on Stealth for 1 hour.

definitions.name: Domain Spells
definitions.summary: Always prepared, not counted against your prepared spells: Charm Person, Disguise Self.

definitions.name: Domain Spells (3rd)
definitions.summary: Always prepared, not counted against your prepared spells: Mirror Image, Pass without Trace.

definitions.name: Domain Spells (5th)
definitions.summary: Always prepared, not counted against your prepared spells: Blink, Dispel Magic.

definitions.name: Domain Spells (7th)
definitions.summary: Always prepared, not counted against your prepared spells: Dimension Door, Polymorph.

definitions.name: Domain Spells (9th)
definitions.summary: Always prepared, not counted against your prepared spells: Dominate Person, Modify Memory.

definitions.name: Channel Divinity: Invoke Duplicity
definitions.summary: Action: create an illusory double within 30 ft for 1 minute (concentration). Move it 30 ft as a bonus action, cast spells from its space, and gain advantage on attacks against creatures within 5 ft of both of you.

actions.name: Invoke Duplicity
actions.note: Illusion within 30 ft, 1 minute (concentration). Bonus action: move it 30 ft. Cast from its space; advantage vs creatures next to you both.

definitions.name: Channel Divinity: Cloak of Shadows
definitions.summary: Action: you become invisible until the end of your next turn, or until you attack or cast a spell.

actions.name: Cloak of Shadows
actions.note: Invisible until the end of your next turn; ends if you attack or cast.

definitions.name: Divine Strike
definitions.summary: Once on each of your turns, a weapon hit deals an extra 1d8 poison damage (2d8 from 14th level).

when.text: once on each of your turns, on a weapon hit

definitions.name: Improved Duplicity
definitions.summary: Invoke Duplicity creates up to four duplicates, and one bonus action moves any number of them.

definitions.name: War Domain
definitions.summary: Battle cleric with heavy armor, martial weapons and divinely guided strikes.

definitions.name: Bonus Proficiencies
definitions.summary: Proficiency with martial weapons and heavy armor.

definitions.name: War Priest
definitions.summary: When you take the Attack action, make one weapon attack as a bonus action. Uses equal your Wisdom modifier (min 1) per long rest.

actions.name: War Priest
actions.note: After taking the Attack action: one extra weapon attack.

definitions.name: Domain Spells
definitions.summary: Always prepared, not counted against your prepared spells: Divine Favor, Shield of Faith.

definitions.name: Domain Spells (3rd)
definitions.summary: Always prepared, not counted against your prepared spells: Magic Weapon, Spiritual Weapon.

definitions.name: Domain Spells (5th)
definitions.summary: Always prepared, not counted against your prepared spells: Crusader's Mantle, Spirit Guardians.

definitions.name: Domain Spells (7th)
definitions.summary: Always prepared, not counted against your prepared spells: Freedom of Movement, Stoneskin.

definitions.name: Domain Spells (9th)
definitions.summary: Always prepared, not counted against your prepared spells: Flame Strike, Hold Monster.

definitions.name: Channel Divinity: Guided Strike
definitions.summary: After seeing your attack roll (before the result), add +10 to it.

actions.name: Guided Strike
actions.note: +10 to one of your attack rolls, decided after the roll.

definitions.name: Channel Divinity: War God's Blessing
definitions.summary: Reaction: a creature within 30 ft gets +10 on an attack roll, decided after the roll.

actions.name: War God's Blessing
actions.note: +10 to an ally's attack roll within 30 ft, after seeing it.

definitions.name: Divine Strike
definitions.summary: Once on each of your turns, a weapon hit deals an extra 1d8 weapon-type damage (2d8 from 14th level).

when.text: once on each of your turns, on a weapon hit

definitions.name: Avatar of Battle
definitions.summary: Resistance to bludgeoning, piercing and slashing damage from nonmagical attacks.

when.text: nonmagical attacks
nonmagical attacks
nonmagical attacks

definitions.name: Forge Domain
definitions.summary: Smith-priest who blesses arms and armor and becomes clad in fire-proof steel.

definitions.name: Bonus Proficiencies
definitions.summary: Proficiency with heavy armor and smith's tools.

definitions.name: Blessing of the Forge
definitions.summary: At the end of a long rest, touch a nonmagical weapon or suit of armor (or shield): it becomes +1 until your next long rest. Once per long rest.

actions.name: Blessing of the Forge
actions.note: Make one nonmagical weapon or armor +1 until your next long rest.

definitions.name: Domain Spells
definitions.summary: Always prepared, not counted against your prepared spells: Identify, Searing Smite.

definitions.name: Domain Spells (9th)

actions.name: Artisan's Blessing
actions.note: 1-hour ritual: craft a metal item worth up to 100 gp.

definitions.name: Soul of the Forge
definitions.summary: Resistance to fire damage, and +1 AC while wearing heavy armor.

when.text: wearing heavy armor

definitions.name: Divine Strike

when.text: once on each of your turns, on a weapon hit

definitions.summary: Immunity to fire damage; in heavy armor, resistance to nonmagical bludgeoning, piercing and slashing damage.

when.text: wearing heavy armor; nonmagical attacks
wearing heavy armor; nonmagical attacks
wearing heavy armor; nonmagical attacks

definitions.name: Grave Domain
definitions.summary: Cleric who guards the line between life and death, reviving the dying and cursing the undead's foes.

definitions.name: Circle of Mortality
definitions.summary: Healing a creature at 0 hit points uses the maximum for each die instead of rolling. You learn Spare the Dying (not counted against cantrips), with 30 ft range and as a bonus action.

definitions.name: Eyes of the Grave
definitions.summary: Action: until the end of your next turn, sense undead within 60 ft not behind total cover. Uses equal your Wisdom modifier (min 1) per long rest.

actions.name: Eyes of the Grave
actions.note: Sense the location of undead within 60 ft until the end of your next turn.

definitions.name: Domain Spells
definitions.summary: Always prepared, not counted against your prepared spells: Bane, False Life.

definitions.name: Domain Spells (3rd)

definitions.name: Domain Spells (5th)

definitions.name: Domain Spells (9th)
definitions.summary: Always prepared, not counted against your prepared spells: Antilife Shell, Raise Dead.

definitions.name: Channel Divinity: Path to the Grave
definitions.summary: Action: curse a creature within 30 ft until the end of your next turn; the next attack that hits it makes it vulnerable to all of that attack's damage.

actions.name: Path to the Grave
actions.note: Curse a creature within 30 ft: the next hit on it before the end of your next turn deals double (vulnerability).

definitions.name: Sentinel at Death's Door
definitions.summary: Reaction: turn a critical hit against you or a creature within 30 ft into a normal hit. Uses equal your Wisdom modifier (min 1) per long rest.

actions.name: Sentinel at Death's Door
actions.note: A critical hit on you or a creature within 30 ft becomes a normal hit.

definitions.summary: Add your Wisdom modifier to the damage of any cleric cantrip you cast.

when.text: cleric cantrip damage

definitions.name: Keeper of Souls
definitions.summary: Once per round, when an enemy you can see dies within 60 ft, you or an ally within 60 ft regains hit points equal to its number of Hit Dice (not constructs or undead).

definitions.name: Order Domain
definitions.summary: Cleric of law and command whose spells spur allies to strike and whose voice compels obedience.

definitions.name: Bonus Proficiencies
definitions.summary: Proficiency with heavy armor, and in Intimidation or Persuasion.

definitions.name: Voice of Authority
definitions.summary: When you cast a 1st-level or higher spell on an ally, one targeted ally can use its reaction to make one weapon attack against a creature you choose.

definitions.name: Domain Spells
definitions.summary: Always prepared, not counted against your prepared spells: Command, Heroism.

definitions.name: Channel Divinity: Order's Demand
definitions.summary: Action: creatures of your choice within 30 ft make a Wisdom save or are charmed until the end of your next turn (or until harmed); you can also make them drop what they hold.

actions.name: Order's Demand
actions.note: Chosen creatures within 30 ft: Wisdom save or charmed until the end of your next turn; may drop held items.

definitions.name: Embodiment of the Law
definitions.summary: Cast an enchantment spell of 1st level or higher that takes an action as a bonus action instead. Uses equal your Wisdom modifier (min 1) per long rest.

actions.name: Embodiment of the Law
actions.note: This turn, an action enchantment spell (1st+) is cast as a bonus action.

definitions.summary: Once per turn, a creature you hit with Divine Strike is cursed until your next turn: the next hit on it by someone else deals an extra 2d8 psychic damage.

definitions.name: Peace Domain
definitions.summary: Cleric who binds allies together in mutual support and protection.

definitions.name: Implement of Peace
definitions.summary: Proficiency in Insight, Performance or Persuasion.

definitions.name: Emboldening Bond
definitions.summary: Action: bond up to proficiency-bonus willing creatures within 30 ft (you can include yourself) for 10 minutes. Once per turn, a bonded creature within 30 ft of another can add 1d4 to an attack, check or save. Uses equal your proficiency bonus per long rest.

actions.name: Emboldening Bond
actions.note: Bond creatures within 30 ft for 10 minutes: +1d4 once per turn while near another bonded creature.

definitions.summary: Action: move up to your speed without provoking opportunity attacks; each creature of your choice you pass within 5 ft of regains 2d6 + Wisdom modifier hit points (once each).

actions.name: Balm of Peace
actions.note: Move your speed, no opportunity attacks; creatures you pass within 5 ft heal 2d6 + Wis.

definitions.name: Protective Bond
definitions.summary: Reaction: when a bonded creature is about to take damage, another bonded creature within 30 ft teleports next to it and takes all the damage instead.

actions.name: Protective Bond

definitions.name: Bonus Proficiencies
definitions.summary: Proficiency with martial weapons and heavy armor.

definitions.name: Eyes of Night
definitions.summary: Darkvision out to 300 ft. Action: share it for 1 hour with willing creatures within 10 ft, up to your Wisdom modifier (min 1); once per long rest, or again by spending a spell slot.

actions.name: Eyes of Night
actions.note: Share 300-ft darkvision for 1 hour with up to Wis mod creatures within 10 ft. Again by spending any spell slot.

definitions.name: Vigilant Blessing
definitions.summary: Action: you or a creature you touch has advantage on its next initiative roll (ends after that roll or if used again).

definitions.summary: Action: a 30-ft sphere of twilight centered on you for 1 minute. A creature of your choice ending its turn in it gains 1d6 + cleric level temporary hit points, or ends being charmed or frightened.

actions.name: Twilight Sanctuary
actions.note: 30-ft aura, 1 minute: allies ending their turn in it gain 1d6 + cleric level temp HP or end charmed/frightened.

definitions.name: Harness Divine Power
